programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: 975000 + 975000 = 1950000; covers Tuition, Academic Support, Hostel, Student Activities & Health. Excludes refundable Caution Deposit (50000) and Mess Deposit (75000/yr). Total Payment amount incl. deposits = 1100000 + 1050000 = 2150000.

programs.salaryNote: NIRF 2026 median salary of placed graduates (graduating AY 2024-25), all 2-year PG programmes combined. The 2026 final placement page (iimamritsar.ac.in/placements/final-placement) gives only top-50/top-50% medians (e.g. 'average CTC for the top 50% of the batch was INR 16.30 LPA, with a median of INR 15.25 LPA'), not an overall batch median.
